profile.name: ERASynth射频信号发生器
profile.description: 一款实验室用射频频率合成/信号发生器，可输出设定频率与功率的射频信号，常作为本振或测试信号源使用。适用于射频与微波实验中的链路测试、器件表征和系统调试；部分相关功能表明设备还带有参考源设置及 Wi‑Fi 模块控制能力。
profile.description_en: A laboratory RF frequency synthesizer and signal generator that outputs RF signals at specified frequency and power levels. It is commonly used as a local oscillator or test source in RF and microwave experiments for link testing, device characterization, and system debugging; available functions also indicate reference source configuration and control of an onboard Wi-Fi module.
